$sources: EN 1991-1-4:2005 Sec 4.2-4.5 (basic velocity, mean wind, turbulence, peak velocity pressure), Table 4.1 (terrain categories), Sec 6.2 (cscd), Sec 7.2.2 and Table 7.1 (walls), 7.2.9 (internal pressure), recommended values
source: EN 1991-1-4 Sec 4 (peak velocity pressure qp(z) from vb,0, the terrain category and co), Sec 7.2.2 Table 7.1 (cpe,10 of zones D and E) and 7.2.2(3) (lack of correlation), Sec 6.2 (cscd = 1 in the simplified cases); recommended values. The project's basic wind speed is vb,0.

0.description: Terrain category 0: sea or coastal area exposed to the open sea

I.description: Terrain category I: lakes or flat horizontal area with negligible vegetation and without obstacles

II.description: Terrain category II: low vegetation such as grass and isolated obstacles (trees, buildings) at least 20 obstacle heights apart

III.description: Terrain category III: regular cover of vegetation or buildings, or isolated obstacles at most 20 obstacle heights apart (villages, suburban terrain, permanent forest)

IV.description: Terrain category IV: at least 15 % of the surface covered with buildings of average height over 15 m

zones.label: side wall, near the windward edge (e/5)

sources.peakVelocityPressure: EN 1991-1-4 Sec 4.2(2) Eq 4.1 (cdir, cseason recommended 1.0), Eqs 4.3-4.5 (cr, kr = 0.19 (z0/z0,II)^0.07, z0,II = 0.05 m, zmax = 200 m), Eq 4.7 (Iv, kI = 1.0), Eq 4.8 (qp = [1 + 7 Iv] ½ ρ vm², ρ = 1.25 kg/m³)
sources.exposures: EN 1991-1-4 Table 4.1: terrain categories 0, I, II, III, IV with z0 and zmin
sources.directionality: cdir = 1.0 (EN 1991-1-4 Sec 4.2(2) Note 2, recommended); a project override applies
sources.topographic: Orography factor co = 1.0 on flat ground (EN 1991-1-4 Sec 4.3.3); a project's hill, ridge or escarpment takes co(z) of Annex A.3 (orography)
sources.orography: EN 1991-1-4 Annex A.3 Eqs A.1-A.5: Φ = H/Lu; co = 1 for Φ < 0.05, 1 + 2 s Φ for 0.05 <= Φ < 0.3, 1 + 0.6 s for Φ >= 0.3 with Le = H/0.3; s upwind A e^(B X/Lu) (-1.5 <= X/Lu <= 0), downwind of hills and ridges A e^(B X/Ld) (0 <= X/Ld <= 2), downwind of cliffs and escarpments A log²(X/Le) + B log(X/Le) + C (0.1 <= X/Ld <= 3.5, z/Le >= 0.1, linear to the crest below 0.1); SAEngine practice: Lu = 2 Lh of the project's topography, Ld = Lu
sources.gust: cscd where the pack's structuralFactor does not decide (the project override)
sources.cpWindward: EN 1991-1-4 Table 7.1, zone D at h/d = 1 (used only when wallPressure is empty)
sources.cpLeeward: EN 1991-1-4 Table 7.1, zone E at h/d = 1 (used only when wallPressure is empty)
sources.wallPressure: EN 1991-1-4 Table 7.1: cpe,10 of zones D (+0.8 at h/d ≥ 1, +0.7 at 0.25) and E (-0.7 at 5, -0.5 at 1, -0.3 at ≤ 0.25), linear between
sources.correlation: EN 1991-1-4 Sec 7.2.2(3) Note: lack of correlation factor 1.0 at h/d ≥ 5, 0.85 at h/d ≤ 1, linear between
sources.structuralFactor: EN 1991-1-4 Sec 6.2(1): cscd = 1 for buildings below 15 m (a) and for frame buildings with structural walls below 100 m and below 4 times the in-wind depth (c); otherwise the detailed procedure of Sec 6.3.1 with Annex B (structuralFactor.detailed)
sources.structuralFactor.detailed: EN 1991-1-4 6.3.1 Eq 6.1, Annex B.1 Eq B.1 (L(z) = Lt (z/zt)^α, Lt 300 m, zt 200 m, α = 0.67 + 0.05 ln z0), B.2 Eqs B.2-B.7 (SL = 6.8 fL/(1 + 10.2 fL)^(5/3), B², R² = π²/(2δ) SL Rh Rb, ηh = 4.6 h fL/L, ηb = 4.6 b fL/L), kp of Annex B Eq B.4 (ν >= 0.08 Hz, T = 600 s, kp >= 3), zs = 0.6 h (Figure 6.1); Annex F Eq F.2 (n1 = 46/h), Table F.2 (δs 0.10 reinforced concrete buildings, 0.05 steel); the aerodynamic damping δa is left out (on the safe side); a steel building gives its damping ratio in Project Settings > Wind (δ = 2π ξ)
sources.internalPressureRange: EN 1991-1-4 Sec 7.2.9(6) Note 2: cpi +0.2 and -0.3 where μ cannot be estimated (reported; cancels in the storey forces)
sources.designCases: EN 1991-1-4 Sec 7.1.2(2), Figure 7.1: torsional effects by the wind force at e = b/10 (Case 2 with the full pressure); no simultaneous cases (each direction alone)
sources.localPressures: EN 1991-1-4 7.2.1 Figure 7.2 (cpe = cpe,1 for A <= 1 m², cpe,1 - (cpe,1 - cpe,10) log10 A, cpe,10 for A >= 10 m²), 7.2.2 Table 7.1 (walls: zones A-E, h/d 5, 1, <= 0.25), 7.2.3 Table 7.2 (flat roofs: zones F-I, sharp eaves and parapets hp/h 0.025, 0.05, 0.10), Figure 7.5 (e = min(b, 2h)), 7.2.9(6) Note 2 (cpi +0.2 and -0.3); the windward wall at qp(h) (its largest)
